title: Review: Yes, we're still arguing about Nolan's The Odyssey
summary: It’s true that Nolan presumes his audience is familiar with Homer’s epic poem and hence many of these characters primarily exist in the margins of Odysseus’ memories. Nolan’s The Odyssey very much deserves to take its place among them.
